item.description:
**Download:** [Leise-2.3.6.zip](https://github.com/ramonfeng/leise/releases/download/v2.3.6/Leise-2.3.6.zip) — quit Leise, then replace the old `Leise.app` in your Applications folder. (First launch after replacing: System Settings → Privacy & Security → "Open Anyway", same as before — [README](https://github.com/ramonfeng/leise#readme).)
## What changed in 2.3.6
- **Leise now checks for updates at leiseapp.com**, its own address, instead of GitHub. As before, it asks about once a day for the latest version number only — nothing about you or your Mac is sent — and you can turn this off at any time in Settings. Nothing else changes in this release.
## The essentials (unchanged)
**Apple Silicon only** (M1 or newer) · **macOS 14.4+** (on-device polishing additionally needs a newer macOS with Apple Intelligence; without it Leise Engine uses its bundled model) · about **5–7 GB free disk** (app + speech models; 2.1 GB less when your Mac's built-in intelligence does the polishing).
A 100 % local dictation app for macOS. Your audio and your transcripts never leave your Mac; it works with the network off.
